tools.name: get_monthly_odds
tools.description: Current 12-month cruise-disruption odds for one of Europe's main cruise rivers (chance a sailing day hits low water, or high water on the Seine). Refreshed daily from official sources.

tools.name: get_live_gauges
tools.description: Today's official water-level readings (cm) at the cruise-critical gauges on the Rhine, Danube, Elbe and Seine, with each station's state and its percentile against thirty years.

tools.name: score_sailing
tools.description: Score a specific river cruise: the chance a sailing departing on a given date meets low water (high water on the Seine) at its river's tightest stretch. tools.name: get_month_detail
tools.description: Why a given month behaves the way it does on one of the four rivers: the seasonal hydrology, the thirty-year frequency, and the last five years' outcomes for that month.
